results.statement: Every connected simple graph G with n vertices and m >= n+1 edges satisfies s^+(G) >= n.
results.notes: All listed papers are partial class results; none resolves the general conjecture.

results.statement: For every connected graph G on n vertices, s^+(G)=n-1 if and only if G is a tree.
results.notes: Do not report against Conjecture 1.2. Requires its own exact Board entry and public resolution action.

results.statement: Every connected cactus G of cyclomatic rank eleven satisfies s^+(G)>|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Strict rank-eleven cactus case of Akbari--Kumar--Mohar--Pragada--Zhang Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Major partial progress only. It neither resolves nor is reported as resolving the general conjecture. AI-generated manuscript and certificate suite are disclosed in the public folder.

results.statement: Every connected cactus whose cyclic blocks are r>=1 triangles and exactly two pentagons satisfies s^+(G)>|V(G)|.
results.source_label: All-rank two-pentagon cactus case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: All-rank cactus subclass theorem, not a resolution of the general conjecture.

results.statement: Every connected cactus G of cyclomatic rank twelve satisfies s^+(G)>|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Strict rank-twelve cactus case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Major partial progress only; not a general resolution.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected cactus G of cyclomatic rank at least two satisfies s^+(G)>|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Complete nonunicyclic cactus case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Completes all cactus graphs in the conjecture's m>=n+1 range, but not the general graph conjecture.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected graph G with |E(G)|=|V(G)|+1 satisfies s^+(G)>|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Complete bicyclic case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Completes the sharp sparse frontier m=n+1, but not the general m>=n+1 conjecture because positive square energy is not known to be edge-monotone.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected graph G with |E(G)|=|V(G)|+2 satisfies s^+(G)>=|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Complete tricyclic case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Completes the full connected m=n+2 frontier, but does not resolve the general m>=n+1 conjecture and is withheld from OCB resolution reporting.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected graph G with |E(G)|=|V(G)|+3 satisfies s^+(G)>=|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Complete tetracyclic case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Completes the full connected m=n+3 frontier, but does not resolve the general m>=n+1 conjecture and is withheld from OCB resolution reporting.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected graph G with |E(G)|=|V(G)|+4 satisfies s^+(G)>=|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Complete pentacyclic case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Completes the full connected m=n+4 frontier, but does not resolve the general m>=n+1 conjecture because positive square energy is not known to be edge-monotone. The manuscript and certificate suite disclose material AI assistance.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected graph G with |E(G)|=|V(G)|+5 satisfies s^+(G)>=|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Complete hexacyclic case of AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Completes the full connected m=n+5 frontier, but does not resolve the general m>=n+1 conjecture because positive square energy is not known to be edge-monotone. Exact segmented certificate executions, hostile audits, and material AI assistance are disclosed.

results.statement: Every finite simple connected graph G of cyclomatic rank seven with exactly one positive-rank cyclic block B, whose loopless 2-connected multigraph kernel obtained by suppressing the degree-two vertices of B has eight vertices, satisfies s^+(G)>=|V(G)|.
results.source_label: Restricted single-block, kernel-order-eight case of Akbari--Kumar--Mohar--Pragada--Zhang Conjecture 1.2
results.notes: Restricted partial progress on AKMPZ Conjecture 1.2 only; not an all-heptacyclic theorem. Tree-free instances are already covered by broader 2026 results. Three historical producer outputs remain explicit byte-pinned trust roots; full mode freshly exact-replays the 29,000 direct-rational packs. Material AI assistance and the absence of claimed human review are disclosed. No external action is authorized until final immutable folder/PDF URLs are recorded, checked, and read back.
